glosses: straight, in a row, in succession, running

examples.en: It is hard to win four successive games.

examples.text: Дорога идёт прямо десять миль подряд.
examples.en: The road is straight for over ten miles.

examples.text: Я три года подряд был работником года.
examples.en: I was employee of the year for three years.
It's been raining non-stop for three days.
